e05-00-problem-l01-sam.speaker: sam
e05-00-problem-l01-sam.text: It wants my ID. And this guy says he can do it for me?

e05-02-lesson-l01-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e05-02-lesson-l01-nexubo.text: Identity checks are usually there to confirm you are the account owner and to meet the rules. Make sure it's the official flow first. Don't hand your ID or codes to an 'agent' in a chat group.

e05-03-lesson-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e05-03-lesson-l01-narrator.text: Usually you enter your real details, upload a supported valid ID, then follow the prompts for a photo or face check. Whether you need proof of address, and which IDs are accepted, depends on your region and platform.

e05-04-lesson-l01-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e05-04-lesson-l01-nexubo.text: If it fails, read the reason first. Is the ID expired? Is there glare? Does the name match? Fix it as instructed. Never try again with a fake identity.

e05-05-lesson-l01-sam.speaker: sam
e05-05-lesson-l01-sam.text: Once I'm done, can I trade right away?

e05-05-lesson-l02-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e05-05-lesson-l02-nexubo.text: Not guaranteed. The result, the products you can use and whether you can deposit all depend on the official notice. And this academy never collects your real ID.

e05-06-lesson-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e05-06-lesson-l01-narrator.text: Who gets your ID? Only the verified official flow. Not us, and not a stranger.

e05-07-conversion-l01-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e05-07-conversion-l01-nexubo.text: Ready to verify? Start only on the official site. Our OKX partner link takes you straight there, with code nexu888 for a fee rebate. We never ask for your ID.

e05-08-hook-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e05-08-hook-l01-narrator.text: Deposit, buy, transfer: three buttons that all look the same. Next: which one to press.

e09-00-problem-l01-sam.speaker: sam
e09-00-problem-l01-sam.text: This network is cheaper. Why not just switch?

e09-02-lesson-l01-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e09-02-lesson-l01-nexubo.text: First confirm which asset and network the receiver supports. Then think about fees. If the two ends don't match, don't send just because it's cheaper. Even USDT can live on different networks.

e09-03-lesson-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e09-03-lesson-l01-narrator.text: For now, think of the network as the route and the address as the destination. But two addresses can look alike and still not work on the same network. Always check that the receiving platform supports this chain and this asset.

e09-04-lesson-l01-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e09-04-lesson-l01-nexubo.text: Copy the address from the receiving page, then check all of it. If a memo or tag is required, fill it in. Confirm the minimum deposit, the withdrawal fee and the amount that will arrive. Don't judge an address by its first and last few characters.

e09-05-lesson-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e09-05-lesson-l01-narrator.text: Send a small test that meets the minimum, and confirm it was actually credited. For a bigger transfer, check everything again. Don't blindly reuse old records. For self-custody transfers, have the network fee ready too.

e09-06-lesson-l02-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e09-06-lesson-l02-nexubo.text: One more check before sending beats looking for help after a mistake.

e09-07-hook-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e09-07-hook-l01-narrator.text: It says 'success', but nothing arrived. Don't send it again. Next: where to look.

e21-00-problem-l01-sam.speaker: sam
e21-00-problem-l01-sam.text: If I put 100 in isolated, the other 900 can never be touched?

e21-02-lesson-l01-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e21-02-lesson-l01-nexubo.text: Isolated margin means a position gets its own margin. In a simple setup, with no adding and no auto-add, this position's liquidation risk is mainly carried by the margin you assigned.

e21-03-lesson-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e21-03-lesson-l01-narrator.text: So it helps you separate the margin of different positions. But that 100 can still be lost. Isolated margin doesn't make losses disappear, and it isn't a stop-loss order.

e21-04-lesson-l01-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e21-04-lesson-l01-nexubo.text: Watch this switch. Some platforms offer auto-add margin. Turn it on, and your available balance can keep flowing into the position. Adding margin by hand does the same. More money ends up carrying the risk.

e21-05-lesson-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e21-05-lesson-l01-narrator.text: Don't see the word 'isolated' and assume the most you can lose is always that first 100. Check the add-margin settings, the fees and the product rules.

e21-06-lesson-l02-nexubo.speaker: nexubo
e21-06-lesson-l02-nexubo.text: With isolated margin, look at the walls, and also at any pipes plugged into the box.

e21-07-hook-l01-narrator.speaker: narrator
e21-07-hook-l01-narrator.text: One position leaks, and another one starts sinking. Next: cross margin.
